settings.text: What people say after the parcel arrives
Every review below comes from someone who ordered from us. We publish the critical ones too, because a page of nothing but five stars helps nobody decide.

settings.title: Exactly what I hoped for
settings.body: Arrived faster than I expected and the quality is genuinely better than the photos. I have already ordered a second one.
settings.author: Sarah M.

settings.title: Worth every penny
settings.body: I was nervous ordering online but the whole thing was smooth. Tracking updated the whole way and support answered me the same day.
settings.author: Daniel R.

settings.title: Really happy with it
settings.body: Took about ten days to reach me, which they were upfront about. No complaints at all, it does exactly what it says.
settings.author: Amelie D.

settings.title: Bought one for my sister too
settings.body: Packaging was neat, everything was as described, and it turned out to be a great gift. Would order again without thinking about it.
settings.author: Marco B.

settings.title: Good, but be patient with shipping
settings.body: The product itself is great and I use it daily. It did take closer to two weeks to arrive, so order early if you need it for a specific date.
settings.author: Priya N.

settings.title: Support sorted my mistake
settings.body: I put the wrong address in at checkout and emailed straight away. They fixed it before it shipped and kept me updated the whole time.
settings.author: Tom H.

settings.summary_note: Every review here comes from a customer who bought from us.
settings.footer_text: Bought from us? We would love to hear how it went. Email us and we will add your review here.

settings.question: How do you collect these reviews?
settings.answer: We email every customer a few days after their order is delivered and ask how it went. Anything they send back, good or bad, can end up on this page.

settings.question: Do you remove negative reviews?
settings.answer: No. We publish critical feedback alongside the positive, and we reply to it. If something went wrong with your order, tell us and we will fix it first.
